title: Gateway secret creation must require the workspace create grant in basic-auth
answers: user without workspace permission can still create a gateway secret or API key
basic-auth gateway secret create bypasses workspace create permission
why does creating a gateway secret succeed when experiment creation is denied
body:
Symptom: With workspaces enabled in basic-auth, a user denied creating experiments and registered models can still create a gateway secret (provider credential).
Root cause: mlflow/server/auth/__init__.py:_authorized_outside_before_request accepted any AFTER_REQUEST_HANDLERS entry as authorization. CreateGatewaySecret had only the after-request MANAGE grant and no BEFORE_REQUEST_HANDLERS validator, so the gap was never flagged.
Fix pattern: Add a validator that returns _user_can_create_in_workspace() (mlflow/server/auth/__init__.py:validate_can_create_gateway_secret) and register it under CreateGatewaySecret in BEFORE_REQUEST_HANDLERS. The after-request ownership grant stays where it was.
Constraints: With workspaces disabled the check allows any authenticated user, which keeps single-tenant behavior. Model-definition and endpoint creates still gate on USE of the referenced resources, not on a workspace create grant; that is a deferred policy change, so do not assume they match.
Applies: basic-auth (--app-name basic-auth) gateway secret create route with MLFLOW_ENABLE_WORKSPACES on.
applies: Basic-auth gateway secret create route when workspaces are enabled; other gateway creates are unchanged.
says: Users denied workspace creation rights can still create gateway secrets and API keys.
Creating a provider credential succeeds even when experiment and model creation is prohibited.
Block users from adding gateway secrets unless they have create permissions in the workspace.
Gateway secret creation bypasses the workspace permission restrictions set for regular users.
search: Creating a gateway secret in basic-auth with workspaces enabled requires a workspace create grant enforced before the request. The validator validate_can_create_gateway_secret in mlflow/server/auth/__init__.py calls _user_can_create_in_workspace() and is registered under CreateGatewaySecret in BEFORE_REQUEST_HANDLERS. When MLFLOW_ENABLE_WORKSPACES is off, any authenticated user is permitted, whereas endpoint and model-definition creation remain gated on USE permissions of referenced resources rather than workspace creation. It applies only to the basic-auth (--app-name basic-auth) gateway secret creation route.
